'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Veer LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Veer]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
